assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original editorial illustration for a scholarly article about choices around paid overtime, sleep and daily life. Wide landscape 3:2. Show a single connected room transitioning from dusk at the left through late night in the centre to first dawn on the right. Three small vignettes of ordinary East Asian adults: left a person closes a laptop and gathers belongings to leave; centre a person quietly working at a desk under a warm lamp with a dark blue window; right a person at a laptop as pale dawn enters, with an empty chair and a jacket. Include subtle ordinary details such as a cup, indoor plant and wall clock without legible numbers. Thoughtful, neutral atmosphere, no moral judgement, no exaggerated distress or medical symptoms. Sophisticated hand-drawn editorial art, fine charcoal contours, restrained watercolour texture, ivory paper, midnight blue, muted teal and ochre. Lots of breathing space. Absolutely no text, numbers, labels, charts, currency signs, logos or watermark. Not a photograph and not a medical image.
assets.role: Conceptual illustration, not empirical or biomedical image

assets.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create an original editorial illustration for a scholarly article about AI-era leisure, attention, companionship and freedom to choose.
